Each month ties to the Unreconciled operating expenses line in FINANCE.EXPENSES.FINANCE_LEDGER. Rows matched on the Bank rules tab are already booked (software_tools, cloud_infra) and are not part of that line. Card payments (type payment) are never spend.\"], [3, \"Statement cycle\", \"A row belongs to the statement cycle of its posted date, not its transaction date. The cycle that closes in month M is ledger month M (January = Dec 26 - Jan 25). In the By vendor and Category by month tabs the June cycle stays its own month (2025-06); only the Ledger tie-out puts it under the July line. Bank-rule rows post on their own and are not affected.\"], [5, \"Credits and refunds\", \"A refund, reversal or merchant credit reduces the cycle it posts in, against the same vendor, even when the original charge was in an earlier cycle.\"], [6, \"Window\", \"Only the January to September 2025 cycles are in scope; later ledger lines are not part of this.\"], [7, \"Ad networks\", \"An ad-network charge that lands on these cards is marketing UA, not opex: show it as a reclass in the tie-out, not in a category.\"], [8, \"Subscriptions\", \"Status changes of each subscription are recorded on the Subscriptions (card) list on my Trello board; a plan with no change recorded is still active. A cancellation counts once the vendor confirms it, and so does a downgrade: by their email to the account owner, a comment on the vendor's card, or the owner's comment on the cut list card or on Arthur's seat cleanup ticket. A change the vendor has confirmed counts even before it is on the board. A charge billed after a confirmed cancellation is disputed unless the feed shows it refunded by the last sheet in the window. An annual plan is still being charged until it lapses.\"], [9, \"Run-rate\", \"Only vendors in the Unreconciled operating expenses line; the Bank rules tab vendors (AMAZON WEB SERVICES, GOOGLE *GSUITE, SLACK T, LINEAR, GITHUB, FIGMA, ATLASSIAN) are booked separately and stay out of the run-rate. Subscriptions and plans only. Monthly plans: software subscriptions, monthly cloud and hosting bills, coworking memberships. Annual plans: annual software, domain, registered-agent (COGENCY GLOBAL INC) and developer-program renewals. Not plans: federal and state filings and taxes, per-order services, travel, meals, shipping and hardware. Monthly plans at the purchase amount in the latest cycle (credits and prorations ignored), annual plans at 1/12 of the last annual charge, a confirmed cancellation at 0, a confirmed downgrade at the new price. Fee rows on a plan count with the plan.\"], [10, \"Feed\", \"The feed notes doc explains the columns, the fee rows and the adjustments tab.\"], [11, \"Workbook\", \"Tabs: By vendor, Category by month, Ledger tie-out, Q4 run-rate. USD to the cent; months as YYYY-MM.\"], [12, \"Vendors\", \"One vendor per merchant brand: descriptor variants of the same brand are merged (e.g. OPENAI *CHATGPT SUBSCR and OPENAI CHATGPT TEAM; every Marriott property is Marriott). {"id": 10, "row_id": "f_0230719d3dcc16f12821d7", "summary": "Inserted: {"title": "SVB card feed - how it works", "body_text": "SVB card feed - how it works\nLeonard, Jan 6 (updated Aug 1)\n\nZapier pulls posted transactions from SVB every night (00:05 Pacific) and writes", "operation": "INSERT", "timestamp": "2026-10-24T12:14:10.851882+00:00", "table_name": "docs_documents", "schema_name": "gdocs", "changed_fields": {"title": "SVB card feed - how it works", "body_text": "SVB card feed - how it works
Leonard, Jan 6 (updated Aug 1)

Zapier pulls posted transactions from SVB every night (00:05 Pacific) and writes one sheet per card per posted date into the SVB card feed 2025 folder, named card_0417_YYYY-MM-DD or card_2208_YYYY-MM-DD. Days with nothing posted still get a sheet with a single 'no postings' row. Dec 26 - Jan 5 were backfilled on Jan 6.

Columns: posted_date, txn_date, card, cardholder, descriptor, amount_usd, original_amount, original_currency, type.
- type is purchase, refund, fee or payment. Refunds and credits are negative. payment is the autopay from the operating account, not spend.
- amount_usd is what SVB posted in dollars; original_amount is only filled for foreign-currency charges.
- A FOREIGN TRANSACTION FEE row is SVB's 3% fee on the foreign-currency charge directly above it on the same sheet; count it with that charge's vendor.

Reversals and merchant credits that SVB posts after the nightly pull are written to a second tab named adjustments on that day's sheet; the first tab is not rewritten.

Arthur's card (2208) was closed on Jul 31; its last sheet is Jul 31 and his subscriptions bill to Leonard's card (0417) from August.

Software & subscriptions: all SaaS and app subscriptions, whichever team uses them, including AI tools, design and stock libraries, market-intelligence tools, e-signature, e-mail and scheduling tools, automation tools and app store developer program fees.
Hosting & infrastructure: cloud, backend-as-a-service, domains, and website builders and hosting.
Research & user testing: paid playtests, surveys and research panels.
Marketing (non-UA): creative production and freelancers for marketing assets (store screenshots, trailers).
Travel & events: flights, hotels, ground transport and conference passes.
Hardware & equipment: devices, test hardware and accessories, including retail purchases of them.
Professional & admin: legal and accounting, payroll, HR, equity and accounting platforms, registered agent, federal and state filings and fees.
Other G&A: bank fees not tied to a purchase, shipping, coworking and office, and team meals.

Paid user acquisition is reported separately and should not be in opex. Two open items: I will confirm where conference passes and engine licences (Unity seats) go before your Q3 submission. These replace the 2024 list.

Best,
